about: Saint-Hyacinthe is in Montérégie, on the rivière Yamaska east of Montréal. It is Québec’s agri-food capital, with a large livestock and food-processing cluster, a veterinary faculty of Université de Montréal, and a regional exhibition grounds. The city has a stone-church skyline and a walkable downtown. About 57,000 people live in Saint-Hyacinthe.
